content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for crypto means utilizing a decentralized payment infrastructure that allows you to transact directly with your customers, bypassing traditional fees and restrictions. Conventional platforms impose hefty fees, such as Gumroad's 10% charge on every sale, which can significantly cut into your profits. By adopting a sovereign commerce stack, you can retain more of your earnings and gain full ownership of your sales process. This framework is especially vital for creators in countries where access to standard payment processors is limited or non-existent.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, a sovereign commerce architecture consists of several integrated components that work together seamlessly. You’ll use platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, ensuring your digital products are accessible. For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script will handle transactions and customer data. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments facilitates the crypto transaction with minimal fees, currently set at just 0.5%. This combination not only streamlines your operations but also enhances security and speed, allowing you to deliver products instantly upon payment confirmation.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who produce Notion templates, eBooks, courses, and other digital products but are restricted from using conventional payment platforms. It empowers creators from regions such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe to gain financial independence by providing them with the tools necessary to sell directly to their audience. By shifting to this model, you can avoid the costly fees associated with platforms like PayPal and Gumroad, allowing you to keep up to 9.5% more of each sale. This autonomy is crucial for building a sustainable digital product business.
Keep 9.5% more of your earnings by avoiding traditional platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack comprises various components that ensure a smooth selling experience. Starting with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, you can publish your Notion templates without ongoing costs. Utilizing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script allows for automated order processing and product delivery. For payment processing, NOWPayments stands out with its support for over 300 cryptocurrencies, charging only a 0.5% fee. This entire setup not only minimizes costs but also guarantees that you maintain complete control over your products and customer data.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your Notion templates using this infrastructure, follow these steps: First, sign up for GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your site. Next, set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic to handle orders efficiently. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing to ensure you receive payments instantly. Load your templates and configure automated delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Lastly, promote your store using social media and digital marketing strategies to reach your audience effectively. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you get all the blueprints and templates needed to streamline this process.
